Our Energy Future

Imagine a future powered by clean energy.

The way we produce and use energy will shape our health, our communities, and our planet. Together, we can picture a cleaner, fairer, and more resilient tomorrow, and start building it today.

Imagine the Future

What could change?

Clean energy is more than a technology. These are some of the everyday changes it can bring.

01

Cleaner air, healthier days

Powering homes with sun and wind instead of burning fuels means clearer skies and less smoke in our neighborhoods.

  • Fewer breathing problems for children and elders
  • Cleaner streets and homes
  • Lower pollution and emissions
02

Power you can count on

Reliable clean energy keeps classrooms, clinics, and homes running, even in the most remote villages.

  • Students can study after dark
  • Clinics keep vital equipment running
  • Fewer and shorter blackouts
03

Energy that belongs to the community

Local clean energy creates local jobs and keeps more resources within our communities.

  • Local jobs and new skills
  • Less reliance on distant fuel supplies
  • Shared decisions, shared progress
04

Lower bills, brighter budgets

Efficient homes and rooftop solar can help families spend less on electricity and more on what matters.

  • Smaller monthly power bills
  • Rooftop solar for homes and schools
  • More stable, predictable energy costs
05

New jobs, new skills

Building, installing, and maintaining clean energy opens up careers for the next generation.

  • Careers in installation and repair
  • Training for young people
  • Cleaner, quieter transport in our cities
What could change?

How each clean energy source could shape our future.

Every source of clean energy from the Learn & Explore page can change daily life in its own way. Choose one to see what could change, what we need to plan for, its pros and cons, and how it connects to Science, Technology and Society (STS).

The Big Ideas

What Will Shape Our Energy Future?

Six ideas that guide how we produce, store, use, move, and share energy.

Renewable Energy

Expanding solar, wind, hydro, and geothermal power where suitable.

Energy Storage

Storing electricity to balance changes in supply and demand.

Energy Efficiency

Using efficient appliances and cutting unnecessary electricity use.

Community Participation

Including local communities in energy decisions and sustainable practices.

Smarter Grids

Modern power lines and controls that share clean electricity more reliably.

Clean Transport

Electric vehicles and public transport that run on cleaner power.

Closer to Home

Philippines’ Energy Future

With sunshine, wind, rivers, and volcanic heat, the Philippines has many natural resources to draw on. Using them wisely can bring cleaner, more reliable power to communities across the islands.

Local opportunities

  • Sun all year. Strong solar potential across the islands.
  • Windy coasts. Good wind sites, especially in northern Luzon.
  • Volcanic heat. Geothermal power is already a national strength.
  • Island microgrids. Local clean power for remote communities.

Challenges to solve

  • Many islands. Connecting thousands of islands to a reliable grid is hard.
  • Typhoons. Power systems must withstand strong storms.
  • Costs and approvals. Financing and permits can slow projects down.
  • Grid upgrades. Storage and transmission must keep up with new supply.
Our shared vision

Imagine it. Then help build it.

A cleaner future begins with what we learn, choose, and do today.
